panels.scene: Walt opening his front door, smiling, Dana on the step with a small suitcase, both happy to see each other. Top third plain wall and sky.
dialogue: You made it. Want to see the bike?
panels.caption: Ask what they want to do.

panels.scene: Dana and Walt at his garage workbench, Walt pointing at a bicycle wheel on a stand, Dana holding a wrench, curious. Top third plain pegboard wall.
panels.caption: Join in on what they already do.

panels.scene: Dana and Walt sitting side by side at a diner counter with two mugs of coffee, Walt turned toward Dana, relaxed. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: So. Tell me about your work.
panels.caption: Let them lead the talk.
